component.name: Branchkeeper
component.summary: Git branch and sync status for the COSMIC panel

description.p: Branchkeeper is a COSMIC panel applet that shows the git status of whatever repository you're working in. The panel shows the repo name, the checked-out branch, and how far ahead of or behind its upstream it is. Click it for the full board: every repository you currently have open, each with its branch, sync state, and uncommitted changes.
It finds your open repositories by looking at where your terminals and file managers are sitting - no configuration, nothing to point it at.
Skeleton: reads branch, ahead/behind, and change count for a repository.
